rules.statement: A landlord is not obliged to give notice before instituting an action for ejectment under section 9 of the Rent Restriction Act, No. 29 of 1948, where a tenant has sub-let the premises in contravention of section 9(1).
rules.supporting_quote: It cannot therefore be said that the landlord is obliged by the common law to give notice before exercising his statutory right under section 9 of the Act. Nor does the statute impose any obligation on him to give notice before proceeding thereunder.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 9 (2) of the Rent Restriction Act, No. 29 of 1948
